mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over three months signals weakening consumer demand, reducing earnings expectations and compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing earnings expectations and compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% over three months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 2% quarter-over-quarter for two consecutive quarters signals accelerating labor market expansion, boosting earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 2% q/q for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarters of PAYEMS > 2% q/q (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units for three consecutive months signals weakening residential demand, reducing construction and related equity earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1,000,000 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 1,000,000 for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 100 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 100 for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in Real Personal Income (RSAFS) above 2% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer purchasing power, boosting earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 2% m/m for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when RSAFS > 2% m/m for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).
